records.completeOriginalProcedure: KEEP Action,60feet,one Beast or Plant gains sentience and language, Instantaneous. NEW eligible target is one actual living nonsapient Beast/Plant creature with recorded INT3or lower, or one rooted living ordinary plant organism not yet a creature, Small through Large or Tiny, fitting within a20-foot cube and weighing at most1000lb. No detached food, seed lot, dead wood, whole forest/colony counted as one, swarm of distinct organisms, already sapient identity or creature with higher operative INT qualifies. These are explicit NEW cognitive/size limits. The target instinctively resists the offered transformation with WIS unless it genuinely accepts through an existing meaningful communication channel; lack of language alone is not consent. For a plant object use the proposed plant profile's WIS0modifier for this admission save. Success prevents change; failure or genuine consent causes the permanent finite changes below, without ongoing concentration. A Beast/Plant creature retains identity,type,size,body,weight,physical abilities,HP/maxHP,Wounds,injuries,age,resources,real skills and existing movement/attacks; set INT to10, and add the ability to understand and speak ONE actual language the caster knows and chose at commitment. It gains independent reasoning and agency, no spell list, class level, tool proficiency, memories, formula knowledge or automatic affection. Speech is a NEW ordinary audible voice from its own body, at normal speaking volume even if its native mouth is not speech-shaped; actual Silence, inability to speak, Unconscious and other permissions still apply. For a previously noncreature plant, keep its real root/body footprint and weight; NEW typePlant, STR1,DEX1,CON10,INT10,WIS10,CHA10, PB2 with no save/skill proficiencies, all Speeds0, no attacks or manipulatory limbs, ordinary hearing within30feet along actual sound paths and touch through its own living body, no sight or remote root-network senses. It may speak, reason and take an ordinary Action that its actual body can perform, never move its roots, Attack, Help on a task it cannot physically assist, use tools or cast from the new profile alone. Keep known original structural maximum/currentHP as the new HP values without repair; if no prior values existed, assign an undamaged base maximum/currentHP of1/5/10/20 for Tiny/Small/Medium/Large, subtracting any already established actual damage, never refreshing a damaged recorded object. Soft living plant AC10 or woodyAC15; retain an actual better-established native structural AC instead. This newly awakened real plant uses ordinary living-creature life/death, not the HP-only summoned zombie rule. Existing wounds/conditions remain; acquiring cognition is not their cure. It is now an autonomous participant: recruiting it as an actual expedition character consumes an ordinary roster place, while merely remaining a living plant does not create a controllable companion. Existing animal bonds/control sources persist only within their real eligibility/ending terms; newly awakened agency permits refusal of ordinary training/voluntary commands, but does not dispel an independent actual magical compulsion. A genuinely retained companion relation still has its one existing attached phase and budgets; converting to an autonomous recruited character ends that companion phase before assigning an ordinary character turn, never both. The instantaneous improvement cannot be dispelled or suppressed afterward, and no ordinary expiry reverses it; a separate legal later transformation/mental effect can override operative abilities within its actual scope, with this gained identity/language retained in history. Recasting a now-sapient target grants no additional language or resource refresh. Actual death does not create another awakened copy or grant this spell resurrection. Sentience's cosmological/soul meaning remains expressly unreviewed.

records.completeOriginalProcedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP creation of a bone cage to trap one creature. NEW select one perceived Large-or-smaller creature and a fixed supported cage position around its actual current body with line of effect. Interior is a ten-foot cube; the frame occupies at most one additional foot outward on each face, giving a twelve-foot exterior cube. Its base must have actual support for a 100-pound structure plus whatever load it already actually bears, with no new bridge/floor spanning a void. The cage is an immovable anchored structure, not a portable vehicle. Before commitment its whole frame must fit without intersecting other creatures, real barriers or displacing the target; no free cutting, crushing, lift or insertion through a wall. The selected target makes DEX. Success causes this proposed cage to fail to form, without a free dodge movement or enclosure of an alternative creature. Failure forms it if placement remains legal. NEW replace Instantaneous with concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds. It has one tracked structure AC 15 and HP 30 across all faces, with vertical bars separated by three-inch gaps; no separate cheaper bar/hinge HP is invented. Bone-like conjured material is resource-ineligible. The captive has its actual movement inside, Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, speech, senses and component capability; trapped does not impose Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Silence or hard-Action denial. Actual anatomy small enough to fit a three-inch gap may pass using ordinary movement; no whole-body passage is inferred solely from a Tiny label. The bars supply NEW half cover, +2 AC and DEX saves, only to a target whose actual attack/effect path crosses them under the ordinary cover rule. They do not block sight or all line of effect, prevent a fitting reach/weapon from passing, or create an automatic line to something otherwise hidden. Actual physical projectiles/objects must fit a gap. Spells retain their own targeting/geometry and only damage this structure if they really include objects. A reachable legal object attack from inside or outside uses the cage’s one AC/HP record; ordinary object type defenses apply, with NEW no additional cage resistance/immunity. At zero structure HP the entire cage ends, leaving a normal opening and actual bodies/cargo in place. NEW an adjacent creature can instead spend an Action on STR (Athletics) against the spell’s snapshotted DC; Core Success/Critical Success permanently bends open one chosen whole ten-foot face of this instance, while failure changes nothing and a later paid attempt is allowed. This work causes no damage to the captive and no damage-derived trigger. A legal teleport can leave; Speed 0 or a restraint immunity is not a general cage escape, and the cage adds no teleport ban. The empty cage remains until ending/replacement, never pursuing its former captive or re-closing an opened face. Concentration loss, expiry, qualifying removal or full creating-source suppression ends the structure permanently under the shared rule, with no renewable bones or later reformation around entrants.

records.completeOriginalProcedure: KEEP Action,one perceived creature60feet and instantaneous infection with a disease. The examined Core spell entry/condition guidance supplies no named complete disease roster; NEW use exactly one chosen fictional profile below, never an imported external Contagion list. Target must be a living creature of a type that is not Construct or Undead, with no actual disease immunity; Beast/Plant bodies can qualify unless their actual source says otherwise. No contact, wound, poison or real-world pathogen is required. The target makes CON vs spellDC; success prevents infection, failure establishes one disease record immediately, with symptoms beginning60elapsed seconds later. The disease is an instantaneous magical cause with an ordinary persistent disease result, not a continuing rank-five spell or curse: counter the initial cast, but later Dispel/suppression alone does not remove it. Disease immunity acquired later suppresses symptoms without curing; Petrified uses its actual suspension rule. Original incubation/recovery/expiry clocks keep running during suspension. Choose Grey Ague (disadvantage on STR ability checks and STR-based attack rolls), Glass Chills (halve each ordinary Speed; same-stat half-Speed penalties use their actual strongest-family arbitration rather than repeated halving), or Moth Haze (disadvantage on INT and WIS ability checks, not saves, attacks or passive scores by an invented extra rule). All are fictional disease profiles, not Poisoned, Exhaustion, ability-score loss, HP damage or mind control. Symptoms do not escalate beyond that one profile. At each24elapsed-hour anniversary from infection make one CON recovery save against the original DC, unaffected by that disease's own check penalties. Three cumulative successes end it; failures do not erase prior successes. It expires unconditionally after seven elapsed days, with expiry first if coincident with a final save. No Long Rest or calendar midnight grants an extra save. NEW thirty uninterrupted minutes of actual Medicine care with ordinary usable medical supplies allows the caregiver one WIS/Medicine task check against the original DC: Success/Critical Success grants advantage on the next scheduled recovery save, and no additional immediate recovery roll. Only one such unspent care benefit exists per disease record and another unchanged attempt cannot stack it; supplies/credentials come from actual inventory, with no newly invented consumed item fee. A permitted actual disease cure ends the selected record and its dependent symptoms, including during suppression. Poisoned-only cures, ordinary healing and Remove Curse do not cure it by name. One Contagion disease per creature across all casters: later failed casts while it remains add no new profile, onset, duration, care benefit or reset successes; other independently sourced diseases remain distinct. No contact spread or epidemic is granted. Death ends this spell-caused disease record, without a corpse transmissibility feature, new harvest trait or immunity promised to later resurrection.

records.completeOriginalProcedure:
KEEP both Evocation and Transmutation source placements, actual class-specific access, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, instantaneous 10d6+40 force and disintegration when reduced to zero HP. NEW choose one perceived creature or independently targetable exposed object with line of effect and a real current/max durability track. A willing or unwilling creature makes DEX; success negates all damage and disintegration, failure receives 10d6+40 force. An eligible immobile object has no creature save; an actually mobile/specially protected object uses its actual applicable profile. Hostile worn/carried possessions cannot be independently selected without a genuine separate permission. This is one selected body/object, not a ray tunneling through a room, automatic wall-of-force removal or deletion of all items in an inventory. An object exceeding its actual damage scale receives only a legal independently profiled exposed section, bounded by a five-foot cube; it is never an automatic whole-building HP proxy.

NEW the disintegration clause belongs to the actual selected target's retained damage branch and requires that this spell's positive normal/structural HP damage take that same target from positive HP to zero after all legitimate defenses, pure prevention, sharing, temporary HP and same-packet survival replacements. Temporary-HP depletion alone is insufficient. The spell does not add a second form pool: Druid, Polymorph and creature-origin object anatomy retain their one real HP ledger. A valid positive-HP survival floor prevents the qualifying zero state. For this new ordering, Disintegrate's conditional disintegration is evaluated after Death Ward and other independently eligible crossing prevention; it is not classified as an outright-death exclusion before that very crossing exists. Core Instant Death and another independently established outright-death source keep their own ordering and exclusions. Same-packet would-die replacement that truly leaves this identity alive above zero also prevents final disintegration. An attempted later healing or resurrection is not such a prior replacement.

After those replacements, a qualifying creature at zero is disintegrated and dies immediately, with no new ordinary dying/death-save interval. This is an explicit NEW direct body-destruction consequence of the source threshold, not a rule that all zero-HP creatures die. A creature already at zero before this packet does not undergo a new positive-to-zero crossing; resolve its ordinary damage/death consequences without inventing this threshold. A protector receiving transferred damage is not automatically disintegrated: the transfer retains force damage and ordinary life consequences, but the original-target disintegration rider does not travel. If the original target retained no positive normal HP loss or stayed above zero, destruction does not occur even if a protector died. Retargeting an actual attack is irrelevant to this save-based spell unless an actual source can retarget this spell itself before its target snapshot.

NEW qualifying destruction converts the selected body's remaining material into mundane inert dust at its actual location; record the identity as dead with its usable corpse material consumed. It creates no harvestable organ, functioning core, magical ingredient or intact significant remains. Dust retains only provenance and its actual mundane mass; it cannot be counted again as the former corpse, restored item, valuable component or full material lot. This does not assert destruction of a soul or establish cosmology. A later resurrection must actually supply missing-body reconstruction, willingness, death-window and all genuine identity restrictions: the reviewed ordinary Resurrection's sufficient-body gate fails, while reviewed True Resurrection may qualify under its own complete rules. A same-body form reversion, snapshot or dispel cannot restore the disintegrated physical stock.

Carried, worn, attached-but-distinct and melded possessions are separate identities and are not erased merely because their bearer dies. Resolve their actual release/body-equipment rules at the remaining location, retaining damage, charges, custody and unique-item restrictions. Native body matter is destroyed with that body; an actual independent prosthetic/device/item is not silently reclassified as native anatomy. An actually disintegrated object loses only that selected object's/section's material and eligible functioning identity; its container contents survive as distinct objects where legally released. An object-origin transformed creature retains its structural-life interface: destruction supplies no organic death saves, soul, corpse or new resurrection right. Creature-origin object anatomy retains its actual character identity and HP history; changing presentation cannot create a replacement body or a second threshold. Ordinary future retrieval, repair or recreation cannot claim unavailable original material. No delayed ongoing source remains to dispel, and no arbitrary immunity or override is inferred from the target's name.

Resolve one instantaneous displacement up to30feet along a declared continuous physically clear path whose every point remains within60feet and caster line of effect; horizontal,vertical and combinations are allowed, with one total30-foot path length. No maintained hand/beam/concentration, free later Action, suspended hover or extra worker remains. A willing creature may accept movement; an unwilling one makes STR vs spellDC, success negates. An unattended unanchored object has no save. A genuinely held loose object instead lets its resisting holder make STR; failure releases that object if physically releasable, success prevents it. Worn/fastened/embedded items, rooted structures, anchored mechanisms and solidly attached cargo cannot be torn free by this spell; target the whole otherwise eligible body/object or use a separately legal release first. There is no contested-check replacement or automatic dismembering attack. A legal declared path can end in air: once the instantaneous support ends, normal unsupported falling begins under the existing Fall Marker, with ordinary actual height and consequences; movement itself adds no attack roll, collision damage, Prone, Grappled or Restrained. Stop at the last legal position if a real blocker appears during resolution; the spell cannot phase through it or crush crowding bodies. Forced separation can end a genuine grapple when reach breaks, while an absolute legal anchor still prevents movement. Real moving-object/terrain hazards apply only on their own printed triggers, once with actual causal identity. Manipulation is gross translation/reorientation of that one object, including moving a freely hinged door if it fits and is not latched/locked; it is not lockpicking, disarming a mechanism, wielding a weapon attack, administering a potion, loading, crafting, providing spell components or supplying a missing hand/tool qualification. Real custody/location and load change once; it neither melds gear nor duplicates a body or inventory. Another actual paid cast may move something again with its own real Action/RP/Dissonance, but there is no stored movement or per-round free repeat from the first one. This explicitly preserves the supplied instantaneous model instead of importing a long-duration external Telekinesis spell.
